title: Event envelope
description: The detail of every event on the bus. Business data lives under data, and has a schema of its own per event type and version.

id.description: Unique per event. The idempotency key a consumer records.

type.description: What happened: past tense, PascalCase, in the language of the glossary.

version.description: Which version of the schema for this type describes data.

source.description: The service that published the event.

occurredAt.description: When it happened in the business, in UTC. Not when it was published.

correlationId.description: The same on every event and log line that stems from one original request.

causationId.description: The id of the event or request that directly caused this one. Absent on the first event of a chain.

data.description: The facts of the event. Described by contracts/events/<Type>.v<version>.schema.json.
